mechanism: Both are thionamide antithyroid agents with overlapping mechanisms of inhibiting thyroid peroxidase and thyroid hormone synthesis, creating redundant pharmacodynamic effects and increased risk of hypothyroidism and agranulocytosis.
action: Avoid concurrent use; these agents should not be combined as monotherapy or adjunctive therapy due to lack of additive benefit and increased toxicity risk—select one agent based on patient factors and clinical indication.
